en.蓝色手枪与红色手枪的零重力决斗场: A blue and red gun duel in zero gravity
en.浏览器需要支持 Canvas 才能运行游戏。: Your browser needs Canvas support to run this game.
en.开火会推动枪身 · 子弹相撞抵消 · 命中三次获胜: Shots propel the gun · Bullets cancel on impact · Three hits to win
en.蓝方获胜，点击再来一局: Blue wins. Click to play again
en.红方获胜，点击再来一局: Red wins. Click to play again
en.黑方先行，连成五子获胜。无禁手。方向键选点，Enter 落子，Z 悔棋。: Black plays first. Connect five to win. No forbidden moves. Arrow keys to move, Enter to place, Z to undo.
en.电脑未能落子，请再试一次: The AI could not move. Please try again.
en.电脑未能落子，请悔棋重试: The AI could not move. Undo and try again.
en.参考经典 Space Cadet 台面风格的三维太空弹球。: 3D space pinball inspired by the classic Space Cadet playfield.
en.蓝色太空印刷台面、银色轨道和红白碰撞器的经典三维弹球台: A blue space-themed pinball table with silver rails and red-and-white bumpers
en.撞击保险杠得分 · 点亮三枚目标提升倍率 · 每局 3 球: Hit bumpers to score · Light three targets to boost the multiplier · 3 balls per game
en.Space 或点击重新开始 · R 重开: Space or click to restart · R to restart
en.单键控制的无尽飞行浏览器游戏。: An endless flying game with one-button controls.
en.黄色小鸟穿越空中障碍: A yellow bird flying between obstacles
en.穿过一组管道得 1 分 · 撞到管道或地面结束: One point per pair of pipes · Hitting a pipe or the ground ends the game
en.Space、点击或触屏重新开始 · R 重开: Space, click or tap to restart · R to restart
en.像素小恐龙跑过仙人掌与飞鸟: A pixel dinosaur running past cacti and birds
en.Space / ↑ 跳跃，↓ 下蹲。跳过仙人掌，躲开飞鸟。: Space / ↑ to jump, ↓ to duck. Clear the cacti and avoid birds.
en.红色赛车在绿色田野间的公路上躲避车流: A red car avoiding traffic on a highway through green fields
en.← / → 转向，↓ / Space 刹车，R 重开。避开车流。: ← / → to steer, ↓ / Space to brake, R to restart. Avoid traffic.
